meta.name: Eyes

videos.title: Nothing Is As It Seems

videos.title: Why We Stay

meta.name: Clean Up Company

videos.title: Saribgunj Ka Law
videos.overview: In crime-ridden Saribgunj, Raju, Swapan and Goldie dream of escaping their dead-end lives. Halua pulls them into a risky job, but a botched kidnapping leaves them with a corpse to dispose of. Meanwhile, IPS officer Indranath Saha challenges gangster-politician Mejda’s influence. As the boys cover their tracks, they find themselves trapped in the very underworld they hoped to escape.

videos.title: Yeh To Marr Gaya
videos.overview: Raju, Swapan and Goldie are forced at gunpoint by Abbas to dispose of a corpse at Goldie’s brickyard. As they desperately try to cover their tracks, the officer Indranath investigates the disappearance of a businessman. Meanwhile, Laila attempts to win Mejda’s favour, while Sultan and Abbas secretly plot their next move. Just when the trio thinks they are safe, Mejda’s involvement puts them in fresh danger.

videos.title: Clean Up Company Hazir Ho
videos.overview: Raju, Swapan and Goldie struggle to keep their involvement in the criminal world hidden while dealing with Mejda’s growing interest in them. Seeing an opportunity, Mejda appoints the trio as Saribgunj’s official Clean-Up Crew and lays down rules for the gangs. Meanwhile, Laila continues plotting against Mejda, while the officer Indranath grows suspicious of the boys and decides to apprehend them.

videos.title: Sarfire Hain Hum
videos.overview: Raju, Swapan and Goldie face Indranath after police find a bloodied car trunk, but escape suspicion with a fabricated story. As Indranath probes Borda’s accident, Abbas offers the trio one final job: trigger a gang war between Sultan and Dharam for their freedom. The plan ends in a massacre, where they make a shocking discovery: Laila is alive among the victims.

videos.title: Shona Don't Be Shy
videos.overview: After witnessing Abbas murder Sultan, Laila claims she has evidence that can destroy him. Raju, Swapan and Goldie reluctantly protect her as IPS officer Indranath Saha investigates the massacre. With Abbas hunting them and a crucial phone holding blackmail material changing hands, the trio is caught between survival, truth and betrayal.

videos.title: Bhoot Ya Borda
videos.overview: A flashback reveals Laila’s painful connection to Borda and why she wants revenge against Mejda. As the trio learns the truth, Swapan devises a risky plan to use Laila’s motive and rumours of Borda’s return to manipulate Abbas. Laila’s father’s journal exposes secrets about Mejda, while Abbas is drawn into a dangerous plan to rob Mejda’s hidden fortune.

videos.title: Saribgunj Ke Soorma
videos.overview: Rumours of Borda’s return make Mejda paranoid as Swapan and Laila manipulate him with threats. Abbas plays both sides while pursuing his own ambitions. After Halua’s death, the Clean-Up Company is desperate to escape Saribgunj. Swapan proposes robbing Mejda’s safehouse, but Raju and Goldie resist. The plan leads them into Abbas’s trap, forcing Goldie to negotiate with Dharam for their freedom.

videos.title: Ikir Mikir Cham Chikir
videos.overview: Mejda pressures Raju’s paralyzed father, Parimal, for information about Borda. Meanwhile, Abbas attacks Mejda’s money house, unaware that Swapan has already tipped Mejda off. With the police led by Indranath closing in, Borda suddenly appears, triggering a final gang standoff. The Clean-Up Company bargains for their families’ safety as Laila and Manisha help secure their escape.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: On the eve of Manu's wedding with Veena, he and Diya decide to elope with the help of their four close confidante cousins.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: At Manu’s wedding, the cousins search for a missing Diya. She arrives and kisses Manu on stage, shocking the families and creating chaos at the wedding, revealing hidden history.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: The cousins reunite at another wedding after ten years. Though Manu feels out of place, the others pull him back into the group and slowly try to rebuild their frayed bond.

videos.title: The Beach Story
videos.overview: Manu insists Diya show him the beach. A casual beach outing turns dangerous when Manu nearly drowns, and Diya is forced to rescue him.

videos.title: Ashwathy's CD

videos.title: The Hard Goodbye
videos.overview: As the wedding celebrations end, the cousins face an emotional goodbye. Manu's attempt to confess his feelings to Diya goes awry, leaving them to part ways on uncertain terms.

videos.overview: At another wedding, adulthood reshapes identities. Old feelings resurface when Manu meets Diya again. New rival Prajith enters, determined to impress her and disrupt emotions.

videos.overview: A playful mishap sparks old childhood memories. As Prajith boldly pursues Diya, Manu finds himself torn between confidence and self-doubt over his feelings.

videos.overview: The cousins collaborate on a wedding video project. Prajith manipulates the elders to present himself as Diya’s ideal match, intensifying rivalry as Manu silently grows uneasy.

videos.overview: The elders subtly push Prajith as Diya’s groom. Family interviews unexpectedly expose old property disputes, revealing unresolved generational tensions beneath celebrations.

videos.title: Old Photos
videos.overview: Family conflicts escalate but resolve through emotional conversations. Manu and Diya share an honest discussion about life, marking a turning point in emotional openness.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: While Sanskriti seeks answers about Manu, Prajith tries to open up to Diya about his feelings. Will their search for the truth bring them closer or strain their relationships?

videos.title: The Roast Disaster
videos.overview: After Prajith hacks Chandu's computer, a roast video plays during the wedding, sparking a major family feud. As tensions rise, Megha boldly confronts the elders.

videos.title: Silent Rift
videos.overview: Chandu and Ashwathy clash over personal matters, driving a wedge between them. On the other hand, Manu is disheartened when he notices Prajith and Diya together.

videos.title: Confession Plan
videos.overview: Manu's plans to confess his love take a dramatic turn when Diya uncovers the truth about the two-timing. Elsewhere, Nima is left shaken after learning the truth about Chandu.

videos.title: Cousins Who Meet at Weddings
videos.overview: Diya tells Manu they should stay like cousins who meet at weddings. The fractured group drifts apart, but Chandu comforts Manu, promising things will mend by the next wedding

videos.title: The Problem Wedding
videos.overview: The cousins return for the next wedding, older now and carrying the weight of things life has taught them. But, this gathering feels different, a threat looms over the celebration.

videos.title: Old Wounds, New Love
videos.overview: Manu's old wounds with his mother reopen as she arrives for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya stays glued to her phone with Jay, her new lover, as Manu watches in silence.

videos.overview: Diya finds Manu alone at a shop. When he opens up about his loneliness and beliefs in marriage, she silences a call from Jay. They share a tender evening under the stars.

videos.title: Unsettled

meta.name: Freedom at Midnight
meta.description: Freedom at Midnight is the electrifying story of India's struggle for independence. Based on the bestselling book of the same name, it recounts the partition of India and Pakistan, and the religious and socio-political dynamics of the era.

videos.title: Direct Action
videos.overview: At the cusp of Independence, leaders from the Congress and the Muslim League meet with Viceroy Wavell in Simla to discuss the Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946. Will the two opposing parties agree on a common future?

videos.title: Sole Spokesman
videos.overview: The aftermath of Direct Action Day places the Muslim league on the inside of the Interim Government formed by the Congress. The coalition causes disharmony at the parliament, jeopardising the governance. In London, Prime Minister Attlee looks for a new viceroy.

videos.title: Satyagraha
videos.overview: As India welcomes a new viceroy, who is going be her last, Gandhi heads to Noakhali on a peace mission. The Mountbattens must juggle interests of the Congress, Muslim League and the Princely States while being objective.

videos.title: Punjab
videos.overview: In the wake of the resignation of the CM of Punjab, the province becomes a political battleground. With communal tensions rising across the country, the Congress is compelled to seriously consider partition.

videos.title: The Last Straw
videos.overview: Mahatma Gandhi meets the Mountbattens and suggests that Jinnah be given Prime Ministership to keep the nation undivided. Will his core allies - Patel and Nehru - agree?

videos.title: Poorna Swaraj
videos.overview: While drafting the Transfer of Power plan for Independent India, V.P. Menon struggles to accommodate the Congress’s need for Poorna Swaraj and the British demand for Dominion Status.

videos.title: Eclipse
videos.overview: Viceroy Mountbatten invites key political leaders of India to come together to present the Transfer of Power plan. However, Mahatma Gandhi abstains from attending the meeting.

videos.title: Borders Of Blood
videos.overview: As independence nears, Sir Cyril Radcliffe is handed the monumental task of drawing the borders to partition a land he knows nothing about. Congress and Muslim League leaders feverishly speculate over which town will fall on which side of the border, as communal tensions continue to flare across the country.

videos.title: Tryst With Destiny
videos.overview: India and Pakistan prepare for their respective days of independence, but the celebrations are fraught with tension and violence. India steps into a new era at the midnight hour, but partition and the division of the army loom large.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: The Boundary Award is announced, igniting outrage on both sides. Gripped by fear, a mass exodus of minorities across the border begins as Nehru and Patel grapple with the consequences of partition. Punjab descends into chaos and horror while Gandhi tries to save Bengal from the same fate. And one refugee vows revenge against the Mahatma.

videos.title: Basket Of Apples
videos.overview: Sardar Patel, V.P. Menon, and Lord Mountbatten strategically approach the various princely states to solidify their accession into India. But the Nawabs and Maharajas of some states refuse to accede without a fight.

videos.title: Kashmir
videos.overview: A tribal invasion into Kashmir instigates the first war between India and Pakistan. Amid the tension in the war-room, Nehru and Patel form opposing views on how to find an end to the war.

videos.title: The Last Fast
videos.overview: Gandhi announces a fast unto death to help restore some semblance of peace between the two communities, and nations. Nehru and Patel have a falling out over the state of the country. Madanlal Pahwa and his allies make their way to Delhi to carry out their sinister plan.

videos.title: Hey Ram!
videos.overview: Gandhi deals with the growing rift between Nehru and Patel. An unknown gunman makes his way to the daily prayer meet held at Birla House. The nation is forced to confront its grief.
